page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 37 at right. One text column in the box, with marginal notes in a right margin column beside it. Signature line at the foot below the text block.

main_text.p: extinctæ religionis accusat ordinem Apostolicum; coætanea huic Matilda, communis à fide Christiana Apostasias; pientissimamque Ecclesiæ, nostro ævo, instaurationem, utraque venturi præscia, clarissimè prænuntiauit; Sancta Brigida fundatrix Ordinis S. Saluatoris ab Vrbano Papa, Canone donata, Papam cruciare, imo crucifigere Electorum animas, palàm docet, omnesq; sequaces eius, fautores, ac clericos abscissum iri; sedemque in profundum inferni demersam prædicit; tam acriter verò istud; vt rogum illi iam tum superstiti, & minitati fuerint,Ex lot. comm. Henr. Token. Illir.Prophet. rythmic.Vita S. Brig. prefixa Reuel.Ann. 1370.Reuel. l. 1. c. 41.Reuel. extra vag. c. 8.

page.notes: The text column is set in a narrow box; the marginal notes are small and partly blurred, so some abbreviations in them are doubtful. The first line of the column begins mid-sentence and the column ends mid-sentence, so the text continues on the next page. Words such as "Henr.Token" and "Illir." in the notes are uncertain. The running head and number are clearly printed.
